result.citation: Santa Ana Mun. Code ch. 8, art. XIX, § 8-3120(a) (Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance, Ord. No. NS-3073); see also id. § 8-3120(c), (d)
result.citation_basis: ch. 8, art. XIX, § 8-3120(a), title 'Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance', Ord. No. NS-3073: O098 (Municode current code, history note) and O063; § 8-3120(c), (d): O063
result.official_quote: After a Tenant has continuously and lawfully occupied a Residential Real Property for thirty (30) days, the Owner of the Residential Real Property shall not terminate the Tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in the written notice to terminate Tenancy.
